mapper.select: SELECT id, requirement_id, request_key, material_ids_json, source_type, project_id, request_payload_json, decision_evidence_json, status, submit_evidence_json, current_marker, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM plt_delivery_submission WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND requirement_id = #{query.requirementId} AND status = 'CURRENT' AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.* FROM plt_delivery_submission s JOIN plt_delivery_fulfillment f ON f.requirement_id=s.requirement_id AND f.tenant_id=s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND f.material_id=#{query.materialId} AND s.deleted=b'0' AND f.deleted=b'0' AND JSON_CONTAINS(s.material_ids_json, CAST(#{query.materialId} AS JSON)) ORDER BY (s.status='CURRENT') DESC, (s.source_type='AUTO_PROJECTION') DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT * FROM plt_delivery_submission WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=b'0' AND archive_status='PENDING_COMPENSATION' AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM plt_delivery_submission WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.submissionId} AND deleted=b'0' AND archive_status='PENDING_COMPENSATION' AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_delivery_submission SET archive_status='PENDING_COMPENSATION',update_time=NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.submissionId} AND deleted=b'0' AND source_type='AUTO_PROJECTION' AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND (request_key LIKE 'report:%' OR request_key LIKE 'satisfaction-result:%') AND (archive_status IS NULL OR archive_status='NOT_REQUIRED')

UPDATE plt_delivery_submission SET archive_status=#{query.archiveStatus},archive_failure_code=#{query.failureCode}, archive_retry_count=archive_retry_count + CASE WHEN #{query.archiveStatus}='PENDING_COMPENSATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time=NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.submissionId} AND deleted=b'0' AND archive_status='PENDING_COMPENSATION'
